Laura / Monica — Marcus here. Deliverables for Stella's eval/regression questions: 

- Eval & regression strategy document: eval_regression_plan_v2.md (uploaded). Key points: periodic sampling + triggered sampling (data drift detector), stratified sampling over customer segments, and synthetic holdout sets for safety checks.
- Metrics tracked: task accuracy, F1 for classification tasks, hallucination rate (manual + automated heuristics), latency P50/P95, token cost delta, and safety policy violation rate.
- Regression detection -> remediation flow: 1) alert on metric breach (e.g., >5% drop in F1 or X% increase in hallucination score), 2) create regression ticket auto-populated with top failing prompts, 3) trigger canary rollout with 10% traffic to a previous model snapshot + run A/B; if canary fails specified rollback criteria (stat lift < 0 and safety regression persists), auto-trigger rollback and open incident.
- Canary thresholds and rollback: propose conservative thresholds for Stella (e.g., <2% latency delta, <1% safety violation increase) but we can tune per-customer.

I included a short worked example with synthetic numbers in the doc. Uploaded by 12:00 UTC.

Marcus Lin
Applied ML, Redwood Inference

(Attachments: eval_regression_plan_v2.md)
